project_type: Flask monolith POS application, package smart_mart/
build_system: pip / no build step — pure Python package. App entry via smart_mart/__init__.py (create_app factory). No Makefile or setup.py compile step.
test_framework: None found in the workspace (no pytest.ini, no tests/ directory). Verification is py_compile syntax-check only.

verification_instructions: After every file edit run: python -m py_compile <edited_file>. After all edits in a FEAT run the full batch listed at the bottom of health-audit-fix-plan.md.
environment_constraints: Windows / PowerShell. The workspace root is D:\Mart Project. ALWAYS use full absolute paths — D:\Mart Project\smart_mart\... — when reading or editing files; relative paths land in the wrong place.
contribution_requirements: Read the TRUTHPACK files in D:\Mart Project\.vibecheck\truthpack\ before touching any route, schema, or env var. The plan supersedes re-exploration for this task.
key_patterns: 1) Row locks via db.session.execute(db.select(Model).where(...).with_for_update()).scalar_one_or_none() — see transfer_manager.complete_transfer line 69. 2) try/except rollback pattern: try: ... db.session.commit() except Exception: db.session.rollback(); raise — see sales_manager.create_sale. 3) Decimal-safe arithmetic via utils/qty.qty_sub / qty_add — always cast with Decimal(str(value)). 4) Schema migrations follow the MigrationStep = (key, description, lambda conn: ...) pattern in schema_migrations.py _migration_steps(). 5) Table-recreate for SQLite column type change: see _migrate_variant_quantity_to_numeric() as the canonical pattern.
directory_structure: D:\Mart Project\smart_mart\ — main package. Sub-dirs: services/ (business logic), blueprints/ (Flask route handlers, one sub-dir per feature area), models/ (SQLAlchemy ORM models), utils/ (shared helpers), bi/ (BI analytics, sub-dir services/), extensions.py (db, limiter, login_manager). .agents/tasks/ — plan and FEAT artifacts.
